summary.zh: 从单份访谈逐字稿中提炼可核对的结论
summary.en: Turn one interview transcript into quote-backed findings

description.zh: 读取一份顾客、专家或可用性访谈的转写稿，按访谈类型整理成结构化结论，每条判断都附原文引用并可回查。适合访谈刚做完、需要快速提炼要点又怕曲解原意的时候。支持 txt、docx、srt 等常见转写格式，需要本地 Python 3 环境。
description.en: Reads one customer, expert or usability interview transcript and grounds each conclusion in a verbatim quote you can check. Good right after interviews when findings must hold up. Supports txt, docx and srt; needs Python 3.
